text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8745123 — hosted-inference-eu p99 latency spike > 2s for 10m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inf?orgId=1&alert=PD-8745123 — needs ack/public impact check.
PagerDuty Bot: auto-ack by `pd-auto-ack` (rule: maintenance-window / suspected duplicate). Agent: none listed.
Alex G.: wait why does it show as ACKed by automation? I wasn't oncall for EU.
Priya S.: same — my rotation isn't until 22:00 UTC. Did the automation misfire? :thinking_face:
Michael T.: seeing obvious customer impact: two customers on tiered-dedicated saw 500s in the last 8m when routing to EU. stack: hosted inference -> router -> dedicated pools EU.
Jia L.: grabbing metrics now. p99 at edge for /v1/generate spiked to 2.6s, 5xx rate up from 0.1% -> 1.8% (10m window).
Alex G.: can someone paste the ack log from PD? I want to know who/what acked this.
PagerDuty Bot: PD audit snippet:
```
2025-06-03T14:02:19Z ALERT PD-8745123 triggered
2025-06-03T14:02:25Z ACK by integration: pd-auto-ack (rule id: 9812)
```
No human acknowledge found.
Priya S.: ok that's the ghost ack. pd-auto-ack is our suppression that tries to auto-ack duplicates. Looks like it matched incorrectly. We need an owner. @Alex G. are you able to take initial triage?
Alex G.: on it. Claiming oncall now. I'm manually claiming the PD incident and will set myself as responder.
Alex G.: claimed PD-8745123, unenabling auto-ack for this alert path to prevent future ghost-acks. cmd: `pd incidents edit PD-8745123 --acknowledge --assign alex.g`
Michael T.: customer impact: two paying customers (Acme Health, NimbusSearch) reported increased error rates; Escalation tier: S1 customer email already queued.
Jia L.: running quick smoke: small subset of inference GPUs showing elevated `cuda_stall` counters after recent runtime kernel bump (kernel v2.14). Suspect regression in kernel scheduling.
Alex G.: good catch. Can we rollback kernel on a small canary to confirm?
Priya S.: recommend mitigations: 1) add routing fallback to us-west for affected customers; 2) scale up EU inference pool by +2 replicas to absorb queue; 3) roll back kernel on a canary host. I'll take #1 and #2.
Priya S.: (action) updating routing policy: `redwood route update --service hosted-inference-eu --fallback us-west --criteria p99>1.5s` — applied.
Priya S.: scaled EU inference pool: +2 replicas (pool eu-prod-1) — scaling in progress.
Jia L.: canary rollback queued. Plan: revert kernel to v2.13 on one canary node, run load test.
Michael T.: sending initial customer comms to affected accounts: draft ready, waiting for confirmation of mitigation. cc @support-team.
Alex G.: running load test on canary now. snippet of failing trace: 
```
2025-06-03T14:05:12Z inference: request_id=abc123 latency=2570ms gpu=eu-gpu-12 cuda_stall=78
2025-06-03T14:05:14Z inference: request_id=abc124 error=Timeout
```

Alex G.: canary rollback complete, testing...
Jia L.: after rollback to v2.13 on canary: p99 dropped to 0.9s on canary under the same load. Looks like kernel v2.14 is the culprit.
Priya S.: great. initiating gradual rollback across EU pool with canary success. Will keep capacity up while rolling.
Michael T.: customer comms sent: "We observed elevated latency affecting a subset of requests in EU. We rolled back a recent runtime update and are monitoring. No data was exposed. ETA for full resolution: 30–45m."
Alex G.: monitoring. p99 for EU now trending down: 2.6 -> 1.2 -> 0.95. 5xx rate falling back to baseline.
PagerDuty Bot: PD incident status changed to RESOLVED by Alex G. (manual) at 2025-06-03T14:18:45Z.
Priya S.: leaving a monitoring handoff to Priya (me) for the next 40m while I coordinate postmortem. @Jia L. please collect kernel telemetry and rollout diff.
Jia L.: will export kernel perf traces + failing GPU IDs, sharing via drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/pm/PD-8745123-traces
Alex G.: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = kernel scheduler regression in runtime v2.14 causing intermittent cuda stalls under specific sequence lengths; triggers: request pattern with sustained high-concurrency short sequences. Mitigation: rollback, disable auto-ack rule matching for this alert type, add canary gating for runtime kernel bumps.
Michael T.: tagging this P1->postmortem. I'll open SEV ticket and notify account execs.
Priya S.: handoff — I'm on monitoring watch for 40m and will take lead on postmortem writeup. If latency reappears, page me oncall immediately.
Alex G.: thanks team. closing thread but leaving PD incident note updated with timeline. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: closing note: `Follow-ups` — add stricter PD rules to avoid ghost-acks, add telemetry alert for kernel upgrade regressions, schedule postmortem in 24h.
Incident Bot: Incident PD-8745123 marked RESOLVED in 00:16:26. Postmortem task created: PM-5321.
